Recycling Calendar

Holiday Service Delays for 2026

New Year's Day - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration, Transfer Station and Hinton Landfill will be closed Thursday, January 1, 2026. 
Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collections normally scheduled on Thursday will be collected on Friday, January 2, 2026.
Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collections normally scheduled on Friday will be collected on Saturday, January 3, 2026.

Martin Luther King Jr. Day - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration and Transfer Station will be closed Monday, January 19, 2026.
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection will not be affected.

Memorial Day - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration and Transfer Station will be closed Monday, May 25, 2026. 
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection will not be affected.

Juneteenth - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration, and Transfer Station will be closed on Friday, June 19, 2026. 
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection will not be affected. 
Please have your carts out by 7 a.m.

Independence Day - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration and Transfer Station will be closed on Friday July 3, 2026. 
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection will not be affected. 
Please have your carts out by 7 a.m.

Labor Day - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration and Transfer Station will be closed Monday, September 7, 2026.
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection will not be affected.

Thanksgiving Day - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration, Transfer Station and Hinton Landfill will be closed Thursday, November 26, 2026. 
Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection normally scheduled on Thursday will move to Friday.

Day After Thanksgiving - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration and the Transfer Station will be closed Friday, November 27, 2026.
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. 
Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection normally scheduled on Friday will move to Saturday. 
Please have your carts out by 7 a.m.

Christmas Eve - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration and Transfer Station will be closed on Thursday, December 24, 2026. 
The Hinton Landfill will be open regular hours. Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection will not be affected.

Christmas - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration, Transfer Station and Hinton Landfill will be closed Friday, December 25, 2026.
Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection normally scheduled on Friday will move to Saturday. 
Please have your carts out by 7 a.m.

New Year's Day 2027 - The Recycling Center, Sanitation Administration, Transfer Station and Hinton Landfill will be closed Friday, January 1, 2027. 
The Hinton Landfill will close at 3 p.m. on Thursday, December 31 and remain closed Friday, January 1.
Trash, recycling, brush and bulky collection normally scheduled on Friday will move to Saturday. 
Please have your carts out by 7 a.m.
